# DAX reference

All measures live in the `_Measures` table. Conventions: fiscal year = July-June (named by the year it ends); time intelligence uses the single conformed `Date` table (marked as date table, contiguous); `DIVIDE` everywhere to avoid divide-by-zero; no implicit measures (`discourageImplicitMeasures`).

**Patterns worth knowing**

- *Rolling windows* use `Date[Month Index]` instead of `DATESINPERIOD`, which includes an extra day when the window starts on a 31st.
- *Headcount* is semi-additive: it returns the snapshot of the **last month-end in the selected period** (`LASTNONBLANK`).
- *YoY* uses `SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR`; use fiscal-year or month granularity - partial calendar years are not like-for-like (data ends 29 Jun 2025).
- *Role-playing dates*: `Order Date` is the active relationship; `Ship Date`/`Due Date` are inactive and used via `USERELATIONSHIP` (`Net Sales by Ship Date`).

## Sales

### Net Sales

Net sales = line total after line discounts (ties to SalesOrderHeader.SubTotal).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales =
SUM ( Sales[Net Sales Amount] )
```

### Gross Sales

List-price revenue before discounts.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Gross Sales =
SUM ( Sales[Gross Sales Amount] )
```

### Discount Amount

Discounts given.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Discount Amount =
SUM ( Sales[Discount Amount] )
```

### Discount %

Discount as a share of gross sales.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Discount % =
DIVIDE ( [Discount Amount], [Gross Sales] )
```

### Units Sold

Units sold.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Units Sold =
SUM ( Sales[Order Quantity] )
```

### Orders

Distinct sales orders.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Orders =
DISTINCTCOUNT ( Sales[Sales Order ID] )
```

### Active Customers

Distinct customers with at least one order in context.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Active Customers =
DISTINCTCOUNT ( Sales[Customer Key] )
```

### Avg Order Value

Net sales per order.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Avg Order Value =
DIVIDE ( [Net Sales], [Orders] )
```

### Online Sales Share %

Share of net sales that came through the online channel.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Online Sales Share % =
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], Sales[Order Channel] = "Online" ), [Net Sales] )
```

### Net Sales % of Total

Net sales as a share of the territories currently selected.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Net Sales % of Total =
DIVIDE ( [Net Sales], CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], ALLSELECTED ( Territory ) ) )
```

### Latest Sales Date

Last order date visible to the current user (respects row-level security).  
Format: `dd mmm yyyy`

```dax
Latest Sales Date =
LOOKUPVALUE ( 'Date'[Date], 'Date'[Date Key], CALCULATE ( MAX ( Sales[Order Date Key] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ) ) )
```

## Time Intelligence

### Net Sales YTD (Fiscal)

Fiscal year-to-date net sales (fiscal year ends 30 June).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales YTD (Fiscal) =
TOTALYTD ( [Net Sales], 'Date'[Date], "6/30" )
```

### Net Sales YTD (Calendar)

Calendar year-to-date net sales.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales YTD (Calendar) =
TOTALYTD ( [Net Sales], 'Date'[Date] )
```

### Net Sales PY

Net sales for the same period one year earlier.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales PY =
CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )
```

### Net Sales YoY Growth %

Year-over-year growth of net sales. Use fiscal-year or month granularity (partial calendar years are not like-for-like).  
Format: `0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%`

```dax
Net Sales YoY Growth % =
VAR _py = [Net Sales PY]
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _py ), DIVIDE ( [Net Sales] - _py, _py ) )
```

### Net Sales YTD (Fiscal) PY

Fiscal YTD net sales one year earlier.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales YTD (Fiscal) PY =
CALCULATE ( [Net Sales YTD (Fiscal)], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )
```

### Net Sales YTD YoY Growth % (Fiscal)

Fiscal YTD growth versus the same point last year.  
Format: `0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%`

```dax
Net Sales YTD YoY Growth % (Fiscal) =
VAR _py = [Net Sales YTD (Fiscal) PY]
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _py ), DIVIDE ( [Net Sales YTD (Fiscal)] - _py, _py ) )
```

### Net Sales MoM Growth %

Month-over-month growth of net sales.  
Format: `0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%`

```dax
Net Sales MoM Growth % =
VAR _pm = CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], DATEADD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) )
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _pm ), DIVIDE ( [Net Sales] - _pm, _pm ) )
```

### Net Sales Rolling 3M Avg

Average monthly net sales over the 3 calendar months ending with the selected period's last month. Uses Month Index (avoids the DATESINPERIOD end-of-month quirk).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales Rolling 3M Avg =
VAR _idx = MAX ( 'Date'[Month Index] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        AVERAGEX ( VALUES ( 'Date'[Year Month Number] ), [Net Sales] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ),
        'Date'[Month Index] > _idx - 3,
        'Date'[Month Index] <= _idx
    )
```

### Net Sales Rolling 12M

Net sales over the 12 calendar months ending with the selected period's last month.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales Rolling 12M =
VAR _idx = MAX ( 'Date'[Month Index] )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        [Net Sales],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ),
        'Date'[Month Index] > _idx - 12,
        'Date'[Month Index] <= _idx
    )
```

### Net Sales by Ship Date

Net sales by ship date (uses the inactive Ship Date relationship).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Net Sales by Ship Date =
CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], USERELATIONSHIP ( Sales[Ship Date Key], 'Date'[Date Key] ) )
```

## Quota

### Sales Quota

Sales quota (quarterly quota spread evenly over the quarter's months).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Sales Quota =
SUM ( Quota[Quota Amount] )
```

### Quota Attainment %

Net sales of quota-carrying salespeople divided by quota.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Quota Attainment % =
DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], Salesperson[Quota Status] = "Quota-carrying" ), [Sales Quota] )
```

### Quota Variance

Quota-carrying sales minus quota.  
Format: `\$#,0;-\$#,0`

```dax
Quota Variance =
CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], Salesperson[Quota Status] = "Quota-carrying" ) - [Sales Quota]
```

## Finance

### COGS

Cost of goods sold = quantity x standard cost valid on the order date.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
COGS =
SUM ( Sales[Standard Cost Amount] )
```

### Gross Margin

Net sales minus COGS.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Gross Margin =
[Net Sales] - [COGS]
```

### Gross Margin %

Gross margin divided by net sales.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Gross Margin % =
DIVIDE ( [Gross Margin], [Net Sales] )
```

### Gross Margin % PY

Gross margin % for the same period one year earlier.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Gross Margin % PY =
CALCULATE ( [Gross Margin %], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )
```

### Gross Margin % YoY Change

Change in gross margin % versus last year (percentage points shown as %).  
Format: `+0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%`

```dax
Gross Margin % YoY Change =
IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Gross Margin % PY] ), [Gross Margin %] - [Gross Margin % PY] )
```

### Freight Billed

Shipping charges billed to customers (SalesOrderHeader.Freight allocated to lines by revenue share).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Freight Billed =
SUM ( Sales[Allocated Freight Amount] )
```

### Sales Tax Billed

Sales tax billed (SalesOrderHeader.TaxAmt allocated to lines).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Sales Tax Billed =
SUM ( Sales[Allocated Tax Amount] )
```

### Total Billed

Net sales + freight + tax = invoiced amount (ties to SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Total Billed =
[Net Sales] + [Freight Billed] + [Sales Tax Billed]
```

### Est. Payroll Cost

Estimated payroll cost = hourly rate x 173.33 hours per employee-month (excludes benefits/overtime).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Est. Payroll Cost =
SUM ( Payroll[Estimated Payroll Cost] )
```

### Gross Margin after Payroll (est.)

Management proxy: gross margin minus estimated company-wide payroll.  
Format: `\$#,0;-\$#,0`

```dax
Gross Margin after Payroll (est.) =
[Gross Margin] - [Est. Payroll Cost]
```

## Supply Chain

### Purchase Spend

Purchase order line totals (excl. freight and tax).  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Purchase Spend =
SUM ( Purchases[Line Total Amount] )
```

### Purchase Freight Cost

Purchase freight allocated to lines.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Purchase Freight Cost =
SUM ( Purchases[Allocated Freight Amount] )
```

### Purchase Spend YoY Growth %

Year-over-year growth of purchase spend.  
Format: `0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%`

```dax
Purchase Spend YoY Growth % =
VAR _py = CALCULATE ( [Purchase Spend], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _py ), DIVIDE ( [Purchase Spend] - _py, _py ) )
```

### PO Lines

Purchase order lines.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
PO Lines =
COUNTROWS ( Purchases )
```

### Purchase Orders

Distinct purchase orders.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Purchase Orders =
DISTINCTCOUNT ( Purchases[Purchase Order ID] )
```

### Active Vendors

Vendors with purchase orders in context.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Active Vendors =
DISTINCTCOUNT ( Purchases[Vendor Key] )
```

### Ordered Qty

Ordered quantity.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Ordered Qty =
SUM ( Purchases[Order Quantity] )
```

### Received Qty

Received quantity.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Received Qty =
SUM ( Purchases[Received Quantity] )
```

### Rejected Qty

Rejected quantity.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Rejected Qty =
SUM ( Purchases[Rejected Quantity] )
```

### Receipt Fill Rate %

Received / ordered quantity.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Receipt Fill Rate % =
DIVIDE ( [Received Qty], [Ordered Qty] )
```

### Reject Rate %

Rejected / received quantity.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
Reject Rate % =
DIVIDE ( [Rejected Qty], [Received Qty] )
```

### On-Time Delivery %

Share of shipped PO lines that shipped on or before their due date.  
Format: `0.0%`

```dax
On-Time Delivery % =
DIVIDE ( SUM ( Purchases[On Time Flag] ), SUM ( Purchases[Shipped Flag] ) )
```

### Avg Days Late

Average days late across shipped PO lines (on-time lines count as 0).  
Format: `0.0`

```dax
Avg Days Late =
DIVIDE ( SUM ( Purchases[Days Late] ), SUM ( Purchases[Shipped Flag] ) )
```

### Inventory On Hand (Qty)

Units on hand (current snapshot, company-wide).  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Inventory On Hand (Qty) =
SUM ( Inventory[Quantity] )
```

### Inventory Value

On-hand quantity x current standard cost.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Inventory Value =
SUM ( Inventory[Inventory Value Amount] )
```

### Products Below Reorder Point

Stocked products whose total on-hand quantity is below their reorder point.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Products Below Reorder Point =
COUNTROWS (
    FILTER (
        VALUES ( Product[Product Key] ),
        VAR _q = [Inventory On Hand (Qty)]
        RETURN NOT ISBLANK ( _q ) && _q < MAX ( Product[Reorder Point] )
    )
)
```

## HR

### Headcount

Employees on the last month-end in the selected period (semi-additive snapshot).  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Headcount =
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Headcount[Headcount Flag] ),
    LASTNONBLANK ( 'Date'[Date], CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Headcount ) ) )
)
```

### New Hires

Employees whose hire date falls in the selected period.  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
New Hires =
SUM ( Headcount[New Hire Flag] )
```

### Avg Tenure (Years)

Average tenure in years at the last month-end of the period.  
Format: `0.0`

```dax
Avg Tenure (Years) =
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE (
        SUM ( Headcount[Tenure Months] ),
        LASTNONBLANK ( 'Date'[Date], CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Headcount ) ) )
    ),
    [Headcount] * 12
)
```

### Headcount YoY Growth %

Headcount growth versus the same period last year.  
Format: `0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%`

```dax
Headcount YoY Growth % =
VAR _py = CALCULATE ( [Headcount], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _py ), DIVIDE ( [Headcount] - _py, _py ) )
```

### Avg Monthly Cost per Employee

Estimated monthly payroll cost per employee.  
Format: `\$#,0`

```dax
Avg Monthly Cost per Employee =
DIVIDE ( [Est. Payroll Cost], SUM ( Payroll[Employee Count] ) )
```

## Security

### Territories Visible

Number of territories the current user can see (RLS test helper).  
Format: `#,0`

```dax
Territories Visible =
COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( Territory[Territory Key] ) )
```

### Current User

Signed-in user as seen by row-level security.

```dax
Current User =
USERPRINCIPALNAME ()
```

### Data Through

Label for report headers.

```dax
Data Through =
"Sales data through " & FORMAT ( [Latest Sales Date], "d mmm yyyy" )
```
